stance.label: Pendirian · Bajet 2027
stance.quote: “Melindungi pekerja tidak bermaksud mengabaikan perniagaan; menyokong perniagaan tidak patut mengorbankan pekerja.”

planks.title: Tempoh peralihan 6–12 bulan
planks.body: Jika gaji minimum (kini RM1,700) dinaikkan, PMKS perlu sekurang-kurangnya 6–12 bulan untuk menyesuaikan diri.

planks.title: Kaji impak dahulu
planks.body: Nilai kesan mengikut sektor, saiz syarikat dan wilayah, dan berunding dengan peniaga sebelum mengumumkan dasar.

planks.title: Gaji naik bersama produktiviti
planks.body: Perluas bantuan untuk pendigitalan, AI, automasi, latihan semula dan TVET supaya syarikat mampu membayar lebih.

planks.title: Semak KWSP 2% pekerja asing
planks.body: Kaji potongan, pengecualian atau sokongan peralihan bagi caruman majikan 2% untuk pekerja bukan warganegara.

stance.note: Lebih 1.2 juta PMKS di Malaysia. DAPSY tidak menentang kenaikan gaji minimum — soalnya bagaimana syarikat mampu membayarnya.

seo.og_description: RMIT Economics & Finance graduate, INTI MBA, property negotiator and a voice for Penang's SMEs and workers.
seo.person_description: Chief of DAPSY Bukit Bendera, Penang (2024–2026); Economics and Finance graduate of RMIT University; Master of Business Administration (MBA), INTI International University (2026); property negotiator at Zeon Properties and leader of AL Team Penang.

hero.role: Chief of DAPSY Bukit Bendera, 2024–2026. Economics graduate and MBA, property professional, a voice for Penang's small businesses and workers.

stats.label: Chief, DAPSY Bukit Bendera · won the election 31–21
Economics & Finance, RMIT University · MBA, INTI (2026)
Personal deals in 3 months (2022), Zeon Properties
Negotiators in the AL Team Penang he leads

stance.label: Stance · Budget 2027
stance.quote: “Protecting workers does not mean ignoring businesses; supporting businesses should not mean sacrificing workers.”

planks.title: A 6–12 month transition
planks.body: If the minimum wage (now RM1,700) rises, micro, small and medium firms need at least 6–12 months to adjust.

planks.title: Assess the impact first
planks.body: Assess the effect by sector, firm size and region, and consult businesses before announcing policy.

planks.title: Wages rise with productivity
planks.body: Expand help for digitalisation, AI, automation, retraining and TVET so firms can afford to pay more.

planks.title: Review the 2% foreign-worker EPF
planks.body: Study deductions, exemptions or transition support for the employer's 2% EPF share for non-citizen workers.

stance.note: Malaysia has over 1.2 million MSMEs. DAPSY does not oppose a higher minimum wage — the question is how firms can sustain it.

items.title: Special Assistant to the Chief Minister → property
items.body: Special Assistant to the Chief Minister of Penang (2018), then moved into property. He now leads AL Team Penang, a team of 20+ real estate negotiators at Zeon Properties.

stance.label: 立场 · 2027 年财政预算
stance.quote: “保护员工，并不等于忽略企业；支持企业，也不应该牺牲员工。”
stance.cite: — 林智成 · 东方日报，2026年10月1日

planks.title: 6 至 12 个月过渡期
planks.body: 若再调高最低薪金（现为 RM1,700），微型及中小型企业至少需要 6 至 12 个月调整。

planks.title: 先做影响评估
planks.body: 按行业、企业规模与地区评估冲击，宣布前与受影响商家充分磋商。

planks.title: 加薪与生产力同步
planks.body: 加强数码化、AI、自动化、员工再培训与 TVET 援助，让企业付得起更高薪水。

planks.title: 检讨外劳 2% 公积金
planks.body: 研究为雇主承担的外劳 2% 公积金提供抵扣、豁免或过渡支援。

stance.note: 全马逾 120 万家微中小企。社青团不反对调高最低薪金 —— 关键是企业怎样长期付得起。
